# SCRUM-212 - Attendee pages show registration state at a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | Story |
| **Epic** | SCRUM-11 - Attendee Registration |
| **Priority** | Medium |
| **Story points** | 1 |
| **Status in Jira** | Done |
| **Sprint** | SCRUM Sprint 4 |
| **Jira** | https://smu-spm-group7.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-212 |

---

**User story:** As an Attendee, I want to see at a glance whether I can register and what my registration says, so that I don't need to ask anyone.

**Acceptance criteria**

1. Each event shows one clear registration state: open with places left, full, not yet open (with the opening time), closed, or registered.
2. My Registrations shows the event, its date and venue, and my status, with Withdraw where allowed.
3. The pages work on a phone (SCRUM-132).

**Customer basis:** Briefing: external users use personal devices, and information "should be clear without assuming familiarity with ConnectSphere's internal processes."

**Why this is a new story:** Browse Events, the event page and My Registrations were built across SCRUM-72 to 77 and 85. Done stories are not reopened.

**Related:** Stretch in Sprint 4. Registration rules (SCRUM-73, 74, 75, 77) are unchanged.

**Change log**

* 2026-10-21: created at Sprint 3 review for Sprint 4 (UI revamp U6). Owner Caylern.
* 2026-10-30 (PO approved, Hann Qian; raised by Felicia in the SCRUM-218 epic check): AC1 adds "not yet open (with the opening time)". #310 already shows it, as SCRUM-75 AC7 requires Attendees to see the opening time before registration opens, so the wording was behind the code. No re-estimate, no code change.

Functionality Area: Attendee Registration
